search_console.decision: The September 7–October 4 report showed 1,214 impressions, two clicks, 0.2% CTR, and average position 35.3. The only nontrivial position 4–20 page signal, Stem Cell CBG with 13 impressions and one click at position 5.3, was already materially expanded on October 8. Remaining position 4–20 rows had one to seven impressions, so no Data-led item was justified; the tiny Montana, homepage, about, pregnancy, pipe, and ashtray samples and one Oklahoma query click were deliberately ignored. Today's work uses evergreen federal evidence and improves nonduplicative discovery paths.

authority.action: Published an FDA-, DailyMed-, NIH-, and MedlinePlus-grounded liver-health evidence guide with a clinician-ready product, medicine, alcohol, symptom, and laboratory record; connected it reciprocally to medicine, prescription-CBD, capsule, and complaint paths; expanded the humidity guide into transparent ownership math; and logged the American Liver Foundation as a qualified resource-review opportunity. No outreach was sent.
